title: DeepStateMap frontline feature
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/deepstate/deepstate_bridge.py every DEEPSTATE_REPUBLISH_S for each Russian/Belarusian unit and attack-direction marker of the DeepStateMap (deepstatemap.live) map. Context data from a Ukrainian volunteer project, updated about daily; every record credits DeepState and the map's update time in remarks. Territory polygons are not published. A feature that leaves the map is retracted with a one-shot {uid, _delete: true} tombstone.

_ts.description: Time of this republish; the layers expire a track two minutes after it.

uid.description: DS-UNIT-<n> or DS-ARROW-<n>, n = the feature's index in the map document.

position_uncertainty_m.description: 5000 for units: DeepState places a unit by its base or area, not a live fix.

stale_s.description: Seconds the layers keep this track without a re-send (zones 600, DeepState markers 600): the bridges re-send rarely because TAK stores every event.
